ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Relief Printmaking. Meets in room 22 Noble Hall. Moving beyond the wood block print, students will experiment with a variety of traditional and contemporary relief printmaking techniques, including hand carving, letterpress, and digital technologies incorportaing use of the laser cutter and CNC router. Projects that relate to work developed in other studio and design areas will be encouraged. Hands-on making will be combined with discussion of the historical arc of printmaking and unique conceptual concerns of print media. This course will explore a range of materials, including plastic, linoleum, and wood, and works produced will range in scale from hand-held to wall-sized. Undergraduate section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or New Media major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
